objectives.description: Add --multi entry point reading newline-separated queries from stdin
Loop sanitize_query() once per query, drop empty entries
Generalize the 3-rung ladder to run per query inside one open connection
Merge across queries: dedupe on chunk_id, keep best rank
Record per-chunk matched_terms as rank tiebreak only
Preserve post-merge pipeline: local-over-global precedence, quarantine, sort, limit slice
Conservative envelope aggregation: query_error only when all sub-queries fail
Add total_matched additive envelope field (pre-limit deduped count)
Confirm single-query path byte-compatible (do_search untouched) and only literature-briefing.sh consumes the envelope

approaches_tried.approach: Embedding a Python docstring with backtick-quoted `queries` inside the unquoted << PYEOF heredoc
approaches_tried.reason: Bash performs command substitution on backticks even inside an unquoted heredoc body, causing a spurious 'queries: command not found' stderr line; fixed by using single-quotes in the docstring instead of backticks.
